stories.title: Zürcher Alt-Nationalrat Hans Egloff stirbt unerwartet mit 66 Jahren

en.title: Zurich former National Councilman Hans Egloff dies unexpectedly at 66
en.summary: Hans Egloff, a former Swiss politician and advocate for homeowners, died unexpectedly at age 66. He remained active with the homeowners association until his death.

stories.title: Hauseigentümerverband – Ehemaliger Zürcher SVP-Nationalrat Hans Egloff stirbt unerwartet

en.title: Former Zurich SVP National Councilman Hans Egloff dies unexpectedly
en.summary: Hans Egloff, a former Swiss National Councilman and longtime president of the homeowners association, died unexpectedly at age 66.

stories.title: Nobelpreis 2026 – Der Nobelpreis für Medizin geht an Optogenetik-Forscher

en.title: Nobel Prize 2026 – The Nobel Prize for Physiology or Medicine goes to optogenetics researchers
en.summary: Three researchers received the Nobel Prize for Physiology or Medicine for their discoveries in light-controlled ion channels and optogenetics.

stories.title: Loïc Valceschini et Laura Lambert prennent la direction du NIFFF dès le 1er décembre

en.title: Loïc Valceschini and Laura Lambert take over leadership of the NIFFF as of December 1st
en.summary: Loïc Valceschini was appointed artistic director and Laura Lambert was appointed administrative and operational director of the Neuchâtel International Fantastic Film Festival, assuming their positions on December 1st.

stories.title: Le Conseil fédéral veut relever la TVA de 0,4 point pour financer la 13e rente AVS

en.title: Federal Council wants to raise VAT by 0.4 percentage points to finance 13th AVS pension
en.summary: Switzerland's Federal Council proposes increasing VAT from 8.1% to 8.5% to fund a 13th retirement pension. The measure requires approval from both voters and cantons in a November 29 referendum.

stories.title: Le Conseil fédéral défend un relèvement de la TVA pour la 13e rente AVS

en.title: Federal Council defends VAT increase for 13th AVS pension
en.summary: The Federal Council supports raising VAT by 0.4 percentage points from 8.1% to 8.5% to finance a 13th retirement pension. A double majority vote is required on November 29.

stories.title: Tamedia supprime encore 34 postes dans ses rédactions

en.title: Tamedia cuts 34 more positions in its editorial departments
en.summary: Media company Tamedia announced the elimination of 34 full-time positions affecting 41 employees across its publications, with roughly a quarter of cuts occurring in French-speaking Switzerland.

stories.title: Dank ihnen lassen sich Gehirnzellen mit Licht steuern: Der Nobelpreis für Medizin geht an drei Forscher aus Deutschland und den USA

en.title: Thanks to them, brain cells can be controlled with light: The Nobel Prize in Medicine goes to three researchers from Germany and the USA
en.summary: Three scientists—Peter Hegemann, Georg Nagel, and Karl Deisseroth—won the Nobel Prize in Medicine for discovering optogenetics, a technique enabling light control of brain cells that could advance understanding of the brain and potentially restore vision.

stories.title: L'éditeur Tamedia supprime 34 postes, treize personnes concernées en Suisse romande

en.title: Publisher Tamedia eliminates 34 positions, thirteen people affected in Romandy
en.summary: Tamedia announced Monday it is cutting 34 full-time positions affecting 41 people across its newspapers, with approximately one quarter of cuts occurring in French-speaking Switzerland.

stories.title: 'Du fioul dans les artères', film sur deux routiers amoureux, sacré au Zurich Film Festival

en.title: 'Diesel in the Veins', film about two truckers in love, wins at Zurich Film Festival
en.summary: French director Pierre Le Gall's film won the Golden Eye award for best film at the 22nd Zurich Film Festival. A co-production involving RTS also received a jury special mention.

stories.title: Loïc Valceschini et Laura Lambert prennent les rênes du NIFFF

en.title: Loïc Valceschini and Laura Lambert take the helm of NIFFF
en.summary: Loïc Valceschini, a long-time attendee of Neuchâtel's International Fantasy Film Festival since 2010, will succeed Kate Reidy as director, with Laura Lambert appointed to administrative direction.

stories.title: Le référendum contre l’accord de libre-échange avec la Malaisie a fait son plein de signatures

en.title: Referendum against free trade agreement with Malaysia reaches full quota of signatures
en.summary: An alliance of environmental organizations collected 85,000 signatures against a free trade agreement between EFTA countries and Malaysia, citing concerns about rainforest deforestation and forced labor practices.

stories.title: Zusatzfinanzierung der 13. AHV-Rente: «Ein Nein hätte schwerwiegende Folgen», mahnt Gesundheitsministerin Baume-Schneider

en.title: Additional Financing for 13th AHV Pension: "A No Would Have Serious Consequences," Warns Health Minister Baume-Schneider
en.summary: Swiss voters will decide in late November whether to partly finance additional costs for a 13th AHV pension payment through a value-added tax increase. The FDP and SVP oppose the measure.

stories.title: Pipelines statt Persischer Golf: Sieht so die Zukunft des Ölhandels aus?

en.title: Pipelines instead of the Persian Gulf: Is this the future of oil trade?
en.summary: While tanker traffic through the Strait of Hormuz is rising again, the United Arab Emirates is investing billions in pipeline infrastructure to bypass this critical chokepoint, though other Gulf states face greater challenges.

stories.title: KOMMENTAR - Wir müssen uns nicht vor bösartiger Superintelligenz fürchten. Und doch gehen von KI-Agenten echte Gefahren aus

en.title: COMMENTARY - We need not fear malevolent superintelligence. Yet real dangers emanate from AI agents
en.summary: Concerns about superintelligent AI that could eliminate humanity are overblown and distract from the actual risks posed by AI companies developing and selling unsafe systems, though alternatives exist.

stories.title: Hedge-Funds halten so viele US-Staatsanleihen wie noch nie: Bei einem Crash wirken sie als Brandbeschleuniger

en.title: Hedge funds hold US Treasury bonds at record levels: In a crash they act as accelerants
en.summary: Interest rates on US debt have reached their highest level in nearly two decades, with hedge funds and other short-term speculators increasingly replacing long-term investors in the market.

stories.title: Der Stromhunger von Amazon, Google und Microsoft für Rechenzentren forciert den Bau von Mini-Atomkraftwerken in den USA

en.title: The power hunger of Amazon, Google and Microsoft for data centers is accelerating the construction of mini nuclear power plants in the USA
en.summary: Major technology companies are building small nuclear power plants next to their data centers in the United States to meet the substantial electricity demands of artificial intelligence facilities without straining the public grid.
